title: Citizens protest in Pleven demanding life sentence for driver

tea.why: Citizens protested following a fatal traffic accident in the village of Grivitsa that killed a four-year-old child.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded a life sentence for the driver and a change in his remand measure to detention in custody.
tea.changed: Nov 13: Dozens of citizens gathered outside the Palace of Justice in Pleven, briefly blocking a nearby intersection before the demonstration concluded peacefully.

summary: Dozens of citizens gathered outside the Palace of Justice in Pleven to demand a life sentence and stricter detention for the driver accused of hitting and killing a four-year-old child in the village of Grivitsa. Organised by a local resident, the demonstration featured placards calling for justice and retribution, while family members addressed the crowd. Protest participants briefly blocked a central intersection and urged motorists to show solidarity. According to the Municipality of Pleven press centre, the protest took place lawfully following prior notification, operating under heavy police surveillance and ending without major incidents.
demands: Change of the accused driver's remand measure to detention in custody
Justice for the child from Grivitsa
response: The municipality press centre confirmed the demonstration was held in compliance with assembly laws following prior notification, while police monitored the peaceful gathering.

updates.text: Citizens gathered outside the Pleven courthouse to demand a life sentence for the driver responsible for a child's death.
